folderName.description: The folder name as chosen in the browser — shown in the coverage panel.

files.description: Up to 500 files. The exact summed-byte cap (RAG_LOCAL_TOTAL_BYTES_LIMIT) and the per-file extension allowlist are enforced by the use case, not by this DTO — an array of individually-valid strings can still add up to a payload too large.

path.description: Relative path within the chosen folder — never absolute, never `..`.
